name: Raoul de Chagny
source:
Despite his boyish charm, he is an officer of the French Navy.

He is enjoying a 6-month leave of absence in Paris prior to going on an expedition to the Arctic. 

His brother and sisters are all much older than him. His parents died when Raoul was still young.

He graduated from the military academy with distinction, and has sailed around the world.
